name: archettu-manga-source
description: Personal manga sources for Suwatte and Venera

scripts.check: npm run build -w @archettu/copymanga && npm run check --workspaces --if-present
scripts.build: npm run build -w @archettu/copymanga && npm run build -w @archettu/suwatte-sources && node scripts/build-site.cjs
scripts.serve:suwatte: npm run build -w @archettu/copymanga && npm run serve -w @archettu/suwatte-sources
scripts.smoke:suwatte: npm run build -w @archettu/copymanga && npm run smoke -w @archettu/suwatte-sources
